note: Submodule of registration. Adds three per-registration-type third-party settings under key registration_confirmation: enable (bool), subject (string), message ({value,format}). An EventSubscriber emails the registrant on completion. Cases are grounded in that third-party config on a registration_type.

evals.prompt: What does the Registration Confirmation submodule do, when does it send its email, and which three settings does it add to each registration type?
evals.expected_output: It sends a confirmation email to the registrant immediately when a registration reaches the completed state. It adds three per-registration-type third-party settings: enable (boolean), subject (string), and message (text_format value/format).

evals.prompt: In the Registration Confirmation submodule, where is the confirmation subject and message stored for a given event type, and is there a global settings page?
evals.expected_output: There is no global settings page; it is configured per registration type as third-party settings: registration.type.<id> -> third_party_settings.registration_confirmation.{enable,subject,message}.

evals.prompt: Can the Registration Confirmation email include the event's title dynamically, and what makes that work?
evals.expected_output: Yes - the subject and message support tokens (e.g. [node:title], plus registration/host tokens) which resolve at send time when the Token module is installed.

evals.prompt: This site has a registration type reg_conf that sends a confirmation email. Inspect its configuration and give the exact confirmation email subject line configured for it.
evals.expected_output: 'Reg Conf Confirmed': registration.type.reg_conf has third_party_settings.registration_confirmation.subject = 'Reg Conf Confirmed' (enable = true).

evals.prompt: On this site, the registration type reg_conf does not currently send a confirmation email. Using the Registration Confirmation submodule, turn on the confirmation email for this registration type and apply the change to the live site.
